description: This source file defines the `MenuHostedItem` struct, which conforms to `NSViewRepresentable`. It wraps a SwiftUI `AnyView` for embedding into an AppKit `NSMenuItem`, facilitating the integration of SwiftUI content into macOS menus by providing necessary view lifecycle methods and sizing logic.

classes.name: MenuHostedItem
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that hosts arbitrary SwiftUI content within an AppKit `NSView`, enabling embedding into native macOS menu items.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates an `NSHostingView` with the specified root view and applies sizing.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the existing `NSHostingView` with a new root view and reapplies sizing.

methods.name: applySizing
methods.description: Sets the frame size of the hosting view based on the specified width and fitting size.
